card.name: Product damage and contamination checks
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, if, showing, visibly, could) right before damage, spoilage or contamination terms in handling and inspection instructions. Also fires on the gap before a wait-time number.

modes.label: Link before damage signs
modes.description: A short word like of, if or visibly comes just before words for cracking, tampering, damage or precipitation.
modes.example: Do not use<< if>> the carton seals have been tampered

modes.description: The space just before a number of minutes in preparation or standing instructions.
